title: The Impact of Choosing a Righteous Spouse on the Offspring

text_simplified: The first pillar of raising children begins before their birth by choosing a righteous spouse who obeys her Lord and cares for her home and children. The Prophet ﷺ said: "A woman is married for four things: for her wealth, for her lineage, for her beauty, and for her religion; so succeed with the one of religion, may your hands be rubbed with dust" (Sahih al-Bukhari 5090). Likewise, a woman and her guardians should strive to choose a righteous husband of sound religion and noble character, so that both spouses unite upon piety and the righteousness of their offspring.
